description: The crookback, no name of a side

participation.context: Played the afternoon, and brought no part-name away.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You read the title and the hour. You did not give the side a name. You read the Rose's bill and stayed.

title: Played Richard the Third

participation.context: Came off, and would not name the side.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Marked him done by the third, and sent him home.
participation.name: Richard Burbage

participation.context: Spent the name, and was not offered a new fool.
participation.name: Will Kemp

relations.note: out of the gown by four
relations.quote: Dead by the third, and the gown off by four

story.body: You were out of the gown by four. You refused the side a name. You left Kemp the jig he already had.

title: Came off dead by the third act, out of the gown by four
